title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along corridors in Sacramento State’s practical off-campus orbit, each paired with one sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: A Park With River Access
cards.subtitle: Carlson Drive corridor — Paradise Beach access
cards.notes: Follow Carlson Drive to the park, then use the city’s amenity list to choose between river access, fitness stations, courts, or fields.
cards.short_summary: A multi-activity park near campus with an entrance to Paradise Beach.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Sacramento lists Glenn Hall Park at 5415 Sandburg Drive with Paradise Beach river access, fitness stations, sports fields, and tennis courts.
cards.source_title: Glenn Hall Park | City of Sacramento
cards.access_notes: Public city park; check posted rules and any permit requirements for reserved picnic or sports areas.

cards.title: Outdoor Seating and Public Art
cards.subtitle: Howe Avenue corridor — 458 Howe Avenue
cards.notes: Walk the center’s outdoor areas to see its metal artwork and redesigned seating, then consult the site plan before choosing a storefront.
cards.short_summary: A redesigned neighborhood center with outdoor gathering features.
cards.evidence_claim: The UV’s official site identifies the center at 458 Howe Avenue and documents updated landscaping, outdoor seating, and art by Jagged Edge.
cards.access_notes: Open-air retail center; individual storefront access and operating hours vary.

cards.title: Build a Frozen-Yogurt Cup
cards.subtitle: Howe Avenue corridor — 484 Howe Avenue
cards.notes: Check the location’s current flavors before heading over, then build a cup from the available frozen yogurt and topping options.
cards.short_summary: A clearly documented frozen-yogurt stop on Howe Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Menchie’s official Howe Avenue page lists the Sacramento shop at 484 Howe Avenue and links its flavors, toppings, cakes, and nutritional information.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists Sun–Thu noon–10 p.m. and Fri–Sat noon–11 p.m.; purchase is required.

cards.title: A Full Grocery Run Near Campus
cards.subtitle: Howe Avenue corridor — 424 Howe Avenue
cards.notes: Use this stop for a planned grocery run; confirm any department-specific service details directly with the store before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A grocery anchor in The UV’s Howe Avenue cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: The UV’s official dining directory lists Safeway at 424 Howe Avenue and identifies it as a tenant of the center.
cards.access_notes: The center directory currently lists daily hours of 6 a.m.–1 a.m.; departments may keep different hours.

cards.title: Groceries and Fresh Flowers
cards.subtitle: Folsom Boulevard corridor — 5000 Folsom Boulevard
cards.notes: Make a short list before visiting; the official store page confirms everyday groceries, bakery goods, produce, cheese, and fresh flowers.
cards.short_summary: A Folsom Boulevard grocery stop with both staples and flowers.
cards.evidence_claim: Trader Joe’s official page places Store 175 at 5000 Folsom Boulevard and lists bakery items, produce, cheese, everyday basics, and fresh flowers.
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; purchase is required.

cards.title: Shop a Market With a Service Deli
cards.subtitle: Folsom Boulevard corridor — 5810 Folsom Boulevard
cards.notes: Call the deli department if you need a specific item prepared; the market publishes separate contacts for deli, produce, meat, and kitchen.
cards.short_summary: An independent market with dedicated food departments.
cards.evidence_claim: Corti Brothers’ official contact page lists its market at 5810 Folsom Boulevard and separate grocery, deli, meat, produce, and kitchen departments.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are Mon–Sat 9 a.m.–7 p.m. and Sun 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; holiday closures may apply.

cards.title: Contemporary Japanese Cooking
cards.subtitle: Folsom Boulevard corridor — 3135 Folsom Boulevard
cards.notes: Review the current menu and reservation details on the restaurant’s site before making the longer westbound trip along Folsom Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A named Japanese restaurant farther west on the Folsom corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Kru’s official website identifies the restaurant as contemporary Japanese cuisine and gives its location as 3135 Folsom Boulevard.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant access requires a purchase; consult the official site for current service hours and reservations.

cards.title: California Comfort Food on H Street
cards.subtitle: H Street corridor — 5340 H Street
cards.notes: Scan the current menu before going, especially if your group needs choices across plates, sandwiches, pizza, soups, salads, or desserts.
cards.short_summary: A broad café menu served on the H Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Selland’s official pages place its H Street café at 5340 H Street and describe California comfort food plus pizzas, sandwiches, soups, salads, and desserts.
cards.source_title: Contact | Selland's Neighborhood Cafe and Bar
cards.access_notes: Restaurant access requires a purchase; confirm current dining and ordering hours on the official site.

cards.title: Bocce Courts and Picnic Space
cards.subtitle: Rodeo Way corridor — 1120 Rodeo Way
cards.notes: Bring bocce equipment or plan a picnic, and check city permitting guidance first if you intend to reserve a field, clubhouse, or group area.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood park organized around bocce, play, and picnics.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Sacramento lists East Portal Park at 1120 Rodeo Way with bocce courts, picnic areas, play areas, a clubhouse, and a softball field.
cards.source_title: East Portal Park | City of Sacramento
cards.access_notes: Public city park; reservations or organized use of the clubhouse, picnic areas, and fields may require permits or fees.

cards.title: A Rose Garden and Jogging Trail
cards.subtitle: Alhambra Boulevard corridor — 601 Alhambra Boulevard
cards.notes: Walk the jogging trail or view the rose garden; contact the city first if you want to reserve the garden or another group-use facility.
cards.short_summary: A large East Sacramento park with gardens and active recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Sacramento lists William McKinley Park at 601 Alhambra Boulevard with a jogging trail, sports courts, play areas, and the Evans Memorial Rose Garden.
cards.source_title: William McKinley Park | City of Sacramento
cards.access_notes: Public city park; reservations, garden events, pool use, and permitted group activities may carry separate fees.
